subject.title: feat(memory): apply temporal decay to QMD search results

question: Should the existing memorySearch.query.hybrid.temporalDecay option intentionally govern QMD ranking and candidate selection as well as builtin hybrid search?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and default-off, but extending an existing setting to another backend changes ranking semantics for opted-in QMD users and therefore requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Unify opt-in semantics
options.body: Confirm that the setting applies across both backends, resolve the current conflicts, and require refreshed integrated QMD proof before merge.

options.title: Keep backend-specific behavior
options.body: Leave QMD ranking unchanged and close or narrow this PR rather than silently broadening the existing option's meaning.

recommendation.title: Unify opt-in semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm that the setting applies across both backends, resolve the current conflicts, and require refreshed integrated QMD proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work directly covers QMD search-mode behavior in the same manager and documentation surface.
